subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-authored dashboard configuration URLs from `SKILL.md`, and if so what typed action and URL trust policy should become the public contract?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix: it adds public skill metadata and makes untrusted or third-party skill-authored URLs actionable from the dashboard, so product and security intent must be explicit before implementation.

options.title: Approve a typed config action
options.body: Define a typed `metadata.openclaw` configuration action with safe URL handling, label/default rules, docs, and dashboard rendering.

options.title: Reuse existing surfaces
options.body: Represent configuration through `homepage`, Skill Cards, or ClawHub metadata instead of adding new frontmatter fields.

options.title: Defer to plugin settings
options.body: Keep core skill metadata unchanged until a broader plugin or ClawHub settings surface is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve a typed config action
recommendation.body: Define a typed `metadata.openclaw` configuration action with safe URL handling, label/default rules, docs, and dashboard rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on the skill metadata/docs path and is the best available routing candidate for a product/security contract decision.
